hints.title: Sorting by Second Endpoint
hints.text: To leave maximum room for future pairs, sort all intervals by their finishing times in ascending order.

hints.title: Greedy Interval Selection
hints.text: Iterate through the sorted pairs. Whenever the start of a pair is strictly greater than the end of the currently chosen pair, select it.

hints.title: Single Pass with High Bound Variable
hints.text: Sort pairs by pair[1]. Initialize curr to negative infinity and count to 0. For each pair (a, b), if a > curr, set curr = b and increment count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N log N) time and O(1) auxiliary space after sorting.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Testing all subsequences takes exponential time, and standard longest increasing subsequence takes O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting by end time enables a greedy choice that is provably optimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should recognize this as the classic activity selection problem with strict inequality.
